spec_match.rationale: Names the exact divergence between the current WICG draft (statics on RTCPeerConnection) and Chromium's shipped rtc.idl (navigator.rtc), sourced from the spec's IDL index and the Chromium source tree, including the RangeError-vs-TypeError metadata divergence from rtc.cc.

interactive.rationale: The probe button re-reads six typeof cells live from the visitor's browser; every cell is a real read, never a hardcoded claim.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises a live divergence table of typeof reads; the page delivers that plus three divergence explainers and a dual-surface detection snippet.

edge_cases.rationale: Verdict copy distinguishes all four exposure states: trial surface only, draft statics only, neither (with honest reasons), and mixed transition.

references.rationale: Feature index cites https://chromestatus.com/feature/5091582546149376; the page links the WICG draft and Chromium rtc.idl directly.

conformance.rationale: The suite's draft-statics-divergence-watch assertion mirrors this page's probe exactly, so the panel and the page agree on the same observable contract.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: clicked probe, all six cells render 'undefined' with the honest neither-surface verdict; zero console errors; screenshots read at both widths.

telemetry_health.rationale: rtc-tracker-probe-ran assert reports both hit counts; no console noise.

design_system.rationale: Table uses bg-stone headers and charcoal text; yes/no cells use accent-emerald/rose on paper (AA); the wide table scrolls inside its own overflow-x container.

accessibility.rationale: Real table semantics with scope'd row/column headers and a caption; the status line is role=status aria-live; the probe control is a native button.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: The min-width table scrolls horizontally inside .matrix-wrap while the page body stays at 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3; desktop clean at 1280×2000.

openQuestions.title: Re-check the divergence table when Chromium lands the draft statics
openQuestions.detail: crbug.com/481412281 tracks the missing spec link; if Chromium migrates to RTCPeerConnection statics the page copy describing 'Divergence #1' should be updated to record the migration (the live table will already show it).

guidanceConsulted.query: data table semantics scope caption screen reader
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native table markup with scoped headers and captions for tabular comparisons.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The matrix is a real <table> with <caption>, scope=col and scope=row headers; verdicts are also mirrored in the aria-live status line.

guidanceConsulted.query: wide comparison table on narrow mobile viewport without page overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wrap wide content in its own overflow-x:auto container so the page body never scrolls horizontally.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: .matrix-wrap owns the horizontal scrolling; verified page overflow 0px at 360px.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): the six typeof cells and the four-state verdict logic behave honestly on Chromium 141 (neither surface exposed). The table is the same observable contract as the suite's divergence-watch assertion, so page and conformance panel cannot disagree.
